q1_issues.issue: The Measure scale slot is filled with `quantity`, a dimension no word in the sentence supplies, whereas Measures & units mandates the reserved symbol `unspecified` for an unstated dimension and warns that such a measure "matches only questions that leave that slot unconstrained" — so this conjunct cannot match a faithfully stored measure (`quantity` is licensed only in the Degree form `(Degree <N> quantity <marker>)`, never as a Measure scale).

q2_gaps: container / measure of-phrase "two vessels of mire-essence" ("a cup of water" is named only as an exclusion from the genitive route): no rule says which entity bears the measure, whether a container noun may fill the unit slot, or what scale such a measure takes — nor whether it is instead a counted group (GroupOf + Cardinality) of vessels
notes: Everything else matches the instruction set: explanation-question shape with (ReasonFor $r $e), Agent for the inanimate transitive subject, Patient for the yielded substance, GroupOf binding for the definite plural, one Time atom per stated granularity, and Past.
